clips.title: The story
paras: During the Lunar Festival, Elder Bloodhoof rests just north of Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. The Bloodhoof tribe honors him as a guardian spirit of its ancestors.

Near Bloodhoof Village, Elder Bloodhoof watches over his people. The tauren honor him as a spirit bound to their lineage and to the plains of Mulgore. During the Lunar Festival, respectful travelers seek his wisdom and receive his blessings. His presence keeps the guidance of dead chieftains and tribal forebears close to the Bloodhoof tribe.
